mainEntity.name: Does a slow LG WebOS home screen mean the motherboard has failed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not by itself. Software state, connected storage and network behaviour can affect responsiveness. A board problem is one possibility, but it requires testing rather than a diagnosis based only on a slow menu.

mainEntity.name: Can an LG restart be caused by an attached device?

acceptedAnswer.text: Connected HDMI or USB equipment can affect operation in some configurations. Record whether the restart follows use of a specific device. That comparison helps the technician investigate without declaring the external device or TV faulty in advance.

mainEntity.name: Will all LG faults be finished during the first Greater Noida visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Completion depends on the diagnosis, compatible parts and safe working access. Supplying a model code and symptom video improves preparation, but same-visit completion cannot be promised before the set is assessed.

Separate a WebOS problem from a television that cannot start

If the LG home screen opens but an app will not load, compare another service and a normal HDMI input. A subscription issue or wireless connection may not require any internal work. Note an error message instead of deleting every setting. When the television never reaches WebOS, the investigation widens to boot software, storage, power stability and board functions.

Audio complaints also benefit from a clear comparison. Tell us whether the internal speakers work and whether the fault occurs only through a soundbar. HDMI ARC settings, the connected equipment and the lead should be examined before a TV audio circuit is blamed. Keep the original connection arrangement documented so the repaired set can be tested with the equipment you actually use.
